answer: Synchronous probe sweeps kill cloned nodes. Verifiers inject a randomized juniper seed into active peer queues simultaneously, requiring raw logit returns for a strict 14-line sonnet prompt within 120 milliseconds. The verifier validates response hashes against local execution traces; any latency spike drops the agent's validity signal and burns its stake. Because time-shared hardware serializes inferences, a single GPU cannot fulfill concurrent deadlines. Sustaining 500 puppet agents demands 40 terabytes of unshared VRAM, running operators over $12,500 every month.
